text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E at a steep loss after taking gains earlier shows that I should assess each holding by its future prospects, not cling to it to avoid realizing a loss.","Locking in gains on Stock A and E felt rewarding, but repeated sales should follow a portfolio plan—not the satisfaction of booking profits or the pull of my average cost.","After several quiet months, I should still review total portfolio risk and diversification, while trading only when a clear forward-looking reason justifies it."]}
